snippet.title: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action is releasing in 2026! Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3605570/Hyper_Bun_Buster_Rocket_Hammer_Action/

Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action is a top-down bump combat action game where you control Tess, a bunny girl who uses her huge hammer to send enemies flying into other enemies!

CREDITS
Programming, Design, Art, Music etc.: DUCK_BERET
Character Design, Key Art: NomnomNami
